content: Installed Skia 2.6.2 accepts shared derived drawing properties; native ReanimatedRecorder captures Group zIndex and native recorder sorts sibling groups after updates, so retain declarative keyed avatar components with derived depth under a common Group. Official Group docs confirm zIndex scope and Paragraph paint inheritance limitation. Picture recording exists but is unnecessary default for dynamic depth. useClock internally owns useFrameCallback; unmount its subtree on blur/background. Sources: official Group/animations docs plus installed Common.ts, Container.native.ts, RNRecorder.h.
